feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so it states no outcome for it. The candidate returns to the iteration 1 controller (kp 2.0, kd 0.2, base_speed 1.4, ki 0, last_direction, weights -2..2) and sensor x positions (-0.02..0.02), and changes only sensor_size from 0.012 to 0.016. Iteration 1 is still the best raced design (75.97). Iteration 4 showed that widening the spacing to -0.03..0.03 cut progress (s-bend 0.29 to 0.157, oval 0.16 to 0.153) without moving max_error, which stayed at 0.062 to 0.064. So the spacing is not the lever, and the footprint is the untested one. The change is a clean single-variable test against the best baseline, and 0.016 is inside the contract's allowed sizes. The main risk is that a larger footprint blurs the signal on tight bends, so progress could fall even though line losses drop. Read the race in this order. (1) If progress on the s-bend and oval falls below iteration 1 levels (0.29 and 0.16) with max_error still near 0.06, revert sensor_size to 0.012 and do not try more footprint changes. (2) If line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom fall below iteration 1's 1.95 and 2.0 while progress holds, keep sensor_size 0.016 and test kd 0.15 to lower steering_oscillation (0.23 on the s-bend at kd 0.2) without giving up progress. (3) If steering_oscillation stays high with max_error near 0.06 and progress holds, test kd 0.15 on its own before touching kp, since kp 2.5 in iteration 3 did not move max_error. Keep ki at 0 unless rms_error shows a steady offset.
requested_changes: If progress falls below iteration 1 levels (s-bend 0.29, oval 0.16) with max_error still near 0.06, revert sensor_size to 0.012, since the wider footprint is costing signal on the bends (iteration 4 showed the same drop from wider spacing).

If line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom drop below iteration 1's 1.95 and 2.0 while progress holds, keep sensor_size 0.016 and lower kd from 0.2 to 0.15 in one step to reduce steering_oscillation, which was 0.23 on the s-bend at kd 0.2 in iteration 1.

If steering_oscillation stays above about 0.2 with max_error near 0.06 and progress holding, lower kd to 0.15 before raising kp, because kp 2.5 in iteration 3 left max_error unchanged at about 0.062 to 0.065.
